stable.headline: Box and Brush select whole parts, the same STEP opens instantly, big files open without freezing, and the app gives memory back.
notes: Box and Brush select whole parts, behind one toolbar button.
Opening the same STEP again is instant.
Big files open without freezing the page.
The app gives memory back after Undo and Delete.
A selection draws at once, and curves are no longer a bundle of lines.
One look for sliders, scrollbars and menus.
